Historico.Name: Back and forward
Historico.Hint: The mouse side buttons (4 and 5), Alt+← and Alt+→, the back and forward keys and the swipe gesture don't take the tab out of the game.

BotaoMeio.Name: Middle button
BotaoMeio.Hint: The middle button doesn't start autoscroll.

Atalhos.Name: Browser shortcuts
Atalhos.Hint: Save, print, open file, view source, bookmarks, history, downloads, help (F1), caret browsing (F7), address bar (Ctrl+L, F6) and browser menu (Alt, F10).

Abas.Name: Tabs and windows
Abas.Hint: Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+1–9 and the like don't close, open or switch the tab. Chrome only passes Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T, Ctrl+N and Ctrl+Tab to the page in fullscreen (F11) or with Foundry installed as an app.

Fechar.Name: Confirm on close
Fechar.Hint: Closing the tab or window with Ctrl or Alt held (Ctrl+W, Alt+F4) asks for confirmation.

Menu.Name: Control Profiles
Menu.Label: Open profiles
Menu.Hint: Keyboard, mouse and controller shortcuts per profile.

Perfis.Name: Control profiles
Perfis.Hint: Opens and closes the control profiles.

Perfis.ConfirmarPadrao: Reset every shortcut in this profile to Foundry's defaults?

Lista.ConfirmarLimpar: Remove the shortcuts of {n} actions in {grupo}?

Dicas.naMao: At hand: no need to move your hand.
Dicas.perto: Close: a little far from your hand.
Dicas.esticar: Stretch: you'll have to move your hand to press it.
Dicas.troca: Hand switch: you'll switch hands to use it.
Dicas.evitar: Avoid: far and slow to press.

Resumo.Atalhos: {acoes} actions bound to {entradas} keys and buttons
Resumo.Perto: All optimized: everything is close to your hands.
Resumo.Algumas: {n} actions are out of reach: you'll switch hands to use them.
Resumo.Longe: Most of your actions are out of reach: you'll keep switching hands and taking your hand off the mouse.

Ergonomia.sistema: Key taken by the system or the browser.
Ergonomia.acidente: Stick: easy to press by accident while moving.
Ergonomia.duasMaos: Modifier and key in different hands: both leave their position.
Ergonomia.dicaMeio: Foundry locks tooltips with the middle button.
Ergonomia.caractere: Stored as a character, not a key code: Foundry doesn't fire this shortcut.
Ergonomia.toques: {n} taps in a row, up to {s} s apart: costs time and fires by accident easily.
Ergonomia.sequencia: {n} keys in sequence, up to {s} s apart.
Ergonomia.juntas: {n} keys together: the second within {s} s of the first.
Ergonomia.segurarTempo: Hold {s} s on every use: good for rare actions or ones that must not fire by accident.
Ergonomia.toquesMovimento: Repeated taps on a movement key fire by accident while walking.
Ergonomia.frequenteComposto: Used {vezes} times: every use pays the combo's time.
Ergonomia.esperaSozinhaTempo: {tecla} alone ({nome}) now waits up to {s} s.
Ergonomia.esperaSozinhaSoltura: {tecla} alone ({nome}) now acts only on release.
Ergonomia.esperaCompostoTempo: Waits up to {s} s because of {gesto}.
Ergonomia.esperaCompostoSoltura: Acts only on release because of {gesto}.

Avisos.Navegador: Browser shortcuts are shown with their default keys. Changes made in your browser's settings aren't reflected here.
